The '''Unyielding Helm''' was the ornamental helm worn by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Karagga]] the Unyielding, [[Supreme Mogul]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. The small bell-shaped hat featured state-of-the-art sensors and systems.
